name: A00_9_the_free_casts_end_with_the_turn
notes: Printed: '[-8]: ... Until end of turn, you may cast spells from your hand without paying their mana costs.' The -8 draws Gnarled Sage ({3}{G}{G}); nothing is cast. Two turns later (the opponent's, then seat 0's own turn 3) with no land and no mana the Sage is no longer offered for free through Chandra: the menu does not offer cast:<Sage>:via:<Chandra>. It stays in the hand. Three Forests below the Sage keep the library from running out before that turn's draw.
